from hermes_tools import write_file, terminal
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u002/system/state/workspace/programs/task-eda4783c.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The full-width divider color marks the line color. Recolor full-height
    # solid lines of that color, preserving all other cells.
    line = next((row[0] for row in grid if all(x == row[0] for x in row)), None)
    if line is None:
        return out
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)):
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][c] = 2
    # Divider itself is recolored as in the examples.
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x == line for x in grid[r]):
            out[r] = [2] * w
    return out
'''
write_file(p,code)
